articles.title: BigBear.ai CEO Kevin McAleenan Delivers Biggest Takeaways from Its Q3 Earnings
articles.summary:
In this NYSE Live interview, Kevin McAleenan, CEO and Board Member of BigBear.ai, discusses the company's third-quarter earnings results, AI-driven growth strategy, and expanding opportunities across defense, intelligence, and critical infrastructure sectors.

Kristen Scholer spoke with McAleenan about recent financial performance, secure AI deployments, government customers, strategic acquisitions, and the company's long-term outlook in an increasingly AI-driven landscape.

A significant portion of the discussion focuses on BigBear.ai's recent earnings performance. McAleenan highlights continued revenue growth, improved business momentum, and raised guidance as signs that the company's growth strategy is gaining traction.

The interview also explores the role of artificial intelligence within national security and mission-critical environments. BigBear.ai develops AI-powered solutions for organizations that require advanced analytics, automation, and decision support while maintaining strict security and compliance standards.

Another major theme is the company's generative AI platform, which allows customers to deploy and manage advanced AI models within secure environments. The platform is designed to support a variety of mission requirements across government agencies and highly regulated industries.

The conversation further examines how BigBear.ai serves customers across defense, intelligence, homeland security, transportation, and industrial sectors. The company's technologies are designed to help operators make faster, more informed decisions in complex operating environments.

The interview also highlights the importance of domain expertise. McAleenan explains that many of BigBear.ai's leaders and employees bring operational experience from defense and security organizations, helping the company develop solutions that align with real-world mission needs.

Another key topic is customer adoption. Organizations increasingly seek AI tools capable of improving productivity, accelerating analysis, enhancing situational awareness, and supporting secure decision-making across critical functions.

The discussion also addresses BigBear.ai's acquisition strategy. The company continues to evaluate opportunities that can enhance technological capabilities, strengthen market positioning, and deliver additional value to customers.
Additionally, McAleenan discusses internal AI adoption and how BigBear.ai leverages artificial intelligence across corporate functions to improve efficiency and streamline business operations.

The conversation further explores broader trends shaping the company's opportunity set, including defense modernization, cybersecurity concerns, critical infrastructure protection, global supply chain challenges, and evolving national security priorities.

Looking ahead, McAleenan believes the combination of strong demand for secure AI solutions, increasing government adoption, strategic acquisitions, and expanding market opportunities positions BigBear.ai for continued growth.

Throughout the discussion, McAleenan shares perspectives on artificial intelligence, generative AI, defense modernization, homeland security, government technology, intelligence analysis, cybersecurity, digital transformation, strategic growth, and innovation.
